logline: A small-town Indore dreamer coasts on the myth that his uncle is an MLA, trading in borrowed clout until reality - and a political rival - forces him to actually grow up.

renewal.note: Three seasons ran from 2018 to 2024. Season 3 premiered April 25, 2024 on Prime Video and Amazon miniTV. No fourth season announced; considered a concluded run.

bollymeter.basis: The debut season earned a 7.5 on IMDb and strong word-of-mouth for Zakir Khan's grounded, self-deprecating comedy. Critics noted how Ronny Bhaiya's small-city delusions ring universally true.

seasons.review_body: Season 1 introduced Ronny Pathak, a 26-year-old from Indore whose only credential is a rumoured uncle-MLA, and Zakir Khan made him instantly recognizable to anyone who grew up manufacturing confidence from thin air. The eight-episode run is low-stakes by design - domestic squabbles, neighbourhood feuds, and romantic near-misses - but the writing keeps the tone warm without tipping into sentimentality. IMDb audience reception settled at 7.5, reflecting strong affection for the Indore milieu. The show's Hinglish register and small-city specificity set it apart from the urban-aspirational comedies dominant on Prime Video at the time.

bollymeter.basis: Season 2 raised the stakes with political rival Vicky Maheshwari and sharpened Ronny's coming-of-age arc, though the three-year gap between seasons made the returning formula feel slightly familiar.

seasons.review_body: Season 2 arrived in March 2021 with Ronny finally meeting a genuine adversary in Vicky Maheshwari, a slicker, more ambitious product of the same small-town ambition machine. Sunny Hinduja's addition gave the season a dramatic spine the first lacked, and Zakir Khan's performance deepened as Ronny's borrowed status started showing cracks. Audience engagement held steady. The DeadAnt review later praised how Season 3 and the run as a whole found 'its true, undiluted voice,' suggesting Season 2 was an important bridge. The writing kept its Indore idiom intact - a deliberate choice that kept the show from chasing pan-India mainstream approval at the cost of authenticity.
seasons.season_over_season: Season 2 introduces a credible rival and raises political stakes, giving Ronny more to push against than domestic comedy alone.

bollymeter.basis: Critics noted Season 3 as the most emotionally honest of the three, with Ronny navigating marriage while the comedy sharpened. DeadAnt called it the run finding its 'true, undiluted voice.'

seasons.review_body: Season 3 premiered in April 2024 simultaneously on Prime Video and Amazon miniTV, the latter free to access - a distribution choice that signalled confidence in the show's mass reach. DeadAnt wrote that Season 3 found the show's 'true, undiluted voice,' describing it as the most emotionally honest of the three installments. The comedy remained rooted in small-city realism, but the emotional register widened without losing the lightness that made Season 1 tick. Ronny's marriage arc resolved the coming-of-age thread that began with a young man borrowing his uncle's reputation and ended with one who no longer needed to.
seasons.season_over_season: Season 3 shifts from political comedy to a marriage arc, delivering the most emotionally resolved chapter of the three.
